title: Navexa AgeCheck entry gate options (GateOptions)
description: The options of NavexaAgeCheck.gate() and the data- attributes of the gate's script tag (agecheck-js, TAX-1873). Every consumer (WooCommerce settings, the free gate generator, BigCommerce, Shopify) validates against this schema and tests against schema/vectors/. The loader accepts exactly what this schema accepts; it ignores anything else (the default is used and a console warning printed). One rule is not expressible here: x-contrast.

x-contrast.description: WCAG 2.x contrast ratio of each resolved pair (defaults filled in), unrounded, must be at least 4.5. Settings UIs refuse a pair under it and the gate generator blocks the copy until it is fixed. The loader falls back to the default pair and warns (warning contrast.<fg>-<bg>). Helper: contrastRatio() in agecheck-js; vectors: vectors/contrast.json.

x-normalization.text: siteName, title, message and every label: Checked as given; then control characters fold to spaces and the ends are trimmed. Empty = the default. Length is in Unicode code points.
x-normalization.attributes: Attribute values are trimmed first, an empty attribute counts as not set, and data-min-age / data-remember-days become numbers when they are 1 to 3 digits. data-theme-<key> and data-label-<key> use kebab-case keys (data-theme-accent-text = theme.accentText); an unknown key is ignored with a warning. data-navexa-gate (valueless, empty or any value) turns the gate on.

mode.description: attest = Yes/No buttons; dob = date of birth (month, day, year), judged in the browser and never stored or sent.

rememberDays.description: How long a Yes is remembered (localStorage navexa_agecheck_gate_v1 = {passedAt, minAge}); 0 = this tab only (sessionStorage).

exitUrl.description: Where an under-age visitor goes: an absolute http: or https: URL that the WHATWG URL parser accepts; empty = a message instead. No gate shows on this URL's own page.

siteName.description: Also the logo's alt text. Checked as given; then control characters fold to spaces and the ends are trimmed. Empty = the default.

title.description: Default: "Welcome", or "Welcome to {site}" with a site name. Checked as given; then control characters fold to spaces and the ends are trimmed. Empty = the default.

message.default: You must be {age} or older to enter this site. Please confirm your age.
message.description: Default (attest): "You must be {age} or older to enter this site. Please confirm your age."; (dob): "You must be {age} or older to enter this site. Please enter your date of birth.". Checked as given; then control characters fold to spaces and the ends are trimmed. Empty = the default.

logoUrl.description: An absolute https: URL (an http: logo is mixed content on https sites); empty = no logo.

theme.description: Colours and font. The backdrop is a colour only (no image) in v1.

backdrop.description: Behind the card, and the page colour while the gate hides it. #rgb or #rrggbb (any case; the loader lower-cases it); empty = the default.

card.description: Card background. #rgb or #rrggbb (any case; the loader lower-cases it); empty = the default.

text.description: Card text. #rgb or #rrggbb (any case; the loader lower-cases it); empty = the default.

accent.description: Buttons and the focus ring. #rgb or #rrggbb (any case; the loader lower-cases it); empty = the default.

accentText.description: Button text. #rgb or #rrggbb (any case; the loader lower-cases it); empty = the default.

font.description: A CSS font-family list, or inherit for the site's own font; empty = the default.

labels.description: Every string on the gate. Checked as given; then control characters fold to spaces and the ends are trimmed. Empty = the default.

invalid.default: Enter a real date of birth: month, day and year.

denied.default: Sorry, you must be {age} or older to visit this site.
